√nabh 'burst'
present: [1.] nábhate etc. -- [9.] nabhnāti -- [4.] nabhyati 
[perfect: nanābha nebhe etc. ]
secondary: causative: anabhayan nambhaya 
derivatives: nábh nabhanú RV. nabhanū́ RV. nabhanyà RV. nábhas V.+ nabhāka RV.B. nábhya V.B.S. nā́bh RV. nā́bhi V.+ 
The connection of part of the derivatives with this root is quite questionable.
